title: Inauguration of the U.P. Film Center
description: Formal inauguration of the U.P. Film Center Fine Arts Complex, featuring speeches of Imelda Marcos, awards, and recognition of leading Filipino filmmakers.
full_description: U.P. Film Center Fine Arts Complex Inaugural: The formal inauguration of the U.P. Film Center Fine Arts Complex, marking the opening of the Film Center’s dedicated facilities and its establishment as a major venue for film education, exhibition, production, and cultural activities at the University of the Philippines. Imelda Romualdez-Marcos was invited. Three young directors were given awards namely Lino Brocka, Ishmael Bernal, and Eddie Romero. Virginia R. Moreno gave a speech.
people_organizations: U.P. Fine Arts Complex; Romualdez-Marcos, Imelda (First Lady, 1929–present); Brocka, Lino (Film Director, 1939–1991); Bernal, Ishmael (Film Director, 1938–1996); Romero, Eddie (Film Director, 1924–2013); Moreno, Virginia R. (Founding Director, U.P. Film Center, 1923–2021)
location: Near Commonwealth Avenue (formerly Don Mariano Marcos Avenue), Quezon City, Philippines
sources: Brochure - U.P. Film Center Fine Arts Complex Inaugural 24 April 1976
